notes.title: Gem Setter: Level Design Contest
notes.content:
Submit a Gem Setter level of your design for a chance to be included in the official level set!  

5 Winning Levels will be chosen and each winner will be included on the official level pack for all to play and enjoy.  In addition, winners will receive early access to the new indie album by game developer and music creator 1f1n1ty.  

Submitted levels must be: 

verified by you
uploaded (old levels are okay!)
vanilla (no hacks or glitches)
thinky (ie. must contain a puzzle)
unique in some way

Don't wait!  Submit your puzzles today via this form: Submission Form

And join us on discord to stay up to speed with all updates from 1f1n1ty: Discord Link
